# douyin-keeper attribution

Source: https://github.com/diyiqiuye/douyin-keeper
Pinned commit: 07d9c52e373f5e2c39da91415d7a53e9e1d7294c
License: MIT (see LICENSE; copyright retained).

Adaptations for Ying-Mo: Flask member authentication, database persistence and queue,
in-memory decrypted credentials, one Chromium process, delivery journal before Enter,
no blind repeat of uncertain sends, exact conversation matching, no screenshots or raw
platform URLs/logs persisted. Original single-account API and scheduler are not loaded.
The extraction helper is also derived from this upstream revision.
